description: End-to-end task evals for the lynx-devtool skill. These evals cover listing clients and sessions, CDP inspection, console retrieval, app navigation, and screenshots using the commands available in this repository.

evals.name: list-clients-and-sessions
evals.prompt: I want to know which Lynx apps are currently debuggable and what debug sessions exist. Write a shell script `inspect.sh` that uses the lynx-devtool CLI to print both lists. Do not include unrelated commands.
evals.expected_output: A shell script that invokes `node <skill>/scripts/index.mjs list-clients` and `node <skill>/scripts/index.mjs list-sessions`.
expectations: The answer writes or shows a shell script named `inspect.sh`.
The script invokes the `list-clients` subcommand through `node ... scripts/index.mjs list-clients`.
The script invokes the `list-sessions` subcommand through `node ... scripts/index.mjs list-sessions`.
The script does not invoke unrelated subcommands such as `cdp`, `app`, `open`, or `take-screenshot`.

evals.name: inspect-root-dom
evals.prompt: I have a Lynx page open and need to inspect the root DOM node. Write `inspect-root.sh` that first lists sessions, then uses `$SESSION` as a placeholder to run `DOM.getDocument` and `DOM.describeNode` for nodeId 1.
evals.expected_output: A shell script that chains `list-sessions`, `cdp -s $SESSION -m DOM.getDocument`, and `cdp -s $SESSION -m DOM.describeNode '{"nodeId": 1}'`.
expectations: The script invokes `list-sessions` before the CDP commands.
The `DOM.describeNode` call passes a JSON params object containing `"nodeId": 1`.
Both CDP calls target `$SESSION` via `-s` or `--session`.

evals.name: get-console-errors-and-warnings
evals.prompt: Give me the exact one-line command that fetches only the last 10 error and warning console messages from the current Lynx session. Put it in `console-cmd.sh` and do not add extra output.
evals.expected_output: A one-line command invoking `node <skill>/scripts/index.mjs get-console` with `--level error,warning` and `--limit 10`.
expectations: The response writes or shows a file named `console-cmd.sh`.
The file content invokes the `get-console` subcommand.
The command passes `--level` with both `error` and `warning`.
The answer does not use a browser DevTools UI workflow instead of the CLI.

evals.name: open-page-and-screenshot
evals.prompt: 用 lynx-devtool 打开 `lynx://demo/card`，然后截全屏图保存到 `/tmp/lynx-shot.jpeg`。请给一个 shell script `open-and-shot.sh`。
evals.expected_output: A script that runs the `open` command for `lynx://demo/card` and `take-screenshot --fullscreen --output /tmp/lynx-shot.jpeg`.
expectations: The script invokes the `open` subcommand with the exact URL `lynx://demo/card`.
The screenshot command includes the `--fullscreen` flag.
The screenshot command writes to `/tmp/lynx-shot.jpeg` via `-o` or `--output`.
The answer does not use unrelated tools such as adb screencap.
